messages:
Jun Park: Dropping a compact dark-theme iteration for the Observability charts. Primary asks: improve series distinguishability in low-res screenshots, make inline code in the right drawer pop, and tighten legend spacing for narrow widths. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-inkline (preview).

Elena Ruiz: Nice baseline. Two quick things: legend labels at 12px are thin on #0b0f12. Either bump to 13px semibold or increase contrast. Also the yellowamber series vanishes in photocopies.

Marco Li: For inline code in the drawer, current approach flattens tokens. Suggest inline bg rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 1px inner stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.04), token palette: keyword #8ceaff, fn-name #bfe8b2, string #ffd79a, number #ffb77a. Block code gets padding 8px and slightly higher bg rgba(255,255,255,0.05).

QA-Bot: Quick automated check: legend text 12px on #0b0f12 => contrast 3.9:1 (FAIL). yellow/amber series => 2.6:1 (FAIL). focus ring missing on legend toggles (FAIL).

Jun Park: Good catches. Proposal: accessible compact palette and tokens below. Open to tweaks.

Elena Ruiz: Proposed series tokens (aim >=4.5:1 vs bg #0b0f12): --blue: #4ea8ff; --warm: #ffb879; --lavender: #c7b3ff; --mint: #79f0c7; legend-text: #e9f6ff. Also add patterned-line variant (dot/dash) for any series still ambiguous in greyscale.

ContrastBot: Post-proposal audit: all series tokens pass contrast (>=5.0:1). legend-text vs bg => 7.1:1 (PASS). recommend focus halo: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18).

Marco Li: I'll add the tokens to theme JSON and update the Figma components with dashed/dotted strokes and marker shapes. Also adding a small CSS util for focus halo + mobile hit area 28px min.

Jun Park: Tiny copy tweak for tooltip: change "Toggle" to "Toggle series visibility" for clarity and screen readers. I'll open a micro PR with theme JSON, CSS util, and the copy change. Tagging QA for verification.

QA-Bot: Note: ensure exported PNGs respect patterned-line styles for printed reports.

Jun Park: Great point  will include export spec in PR. Planning to ship as a patch after QA sign-off. Closing thread when PR is merged. :rocket:
